title: Home-style 四菜一汤 meals from the user's reference creator (3 videos, 15 dishes + rice)
source: C:/Users/admin/Downloads/今日食谱*.mp4 (user-provided, Douyin-style 720x1280, 4.1-4.7 min each). Frames every 2 s (scratchpad home3/sheet_*.jpg) and Whisper-medium transcripts (home3/v1-3.txt). Times in [m:ss] are video times. On-screen captions and his narration are quoted; ASR errors corrected only where the caption shows the right word (文革->文蛤, 炖中->炖盅).
